path.description: Hono-style path with :param captures, e.g. /users/:id. GraphQL is modeled as POST /graphql.

auth.description: Auth match hints, e.g. { header: 'authorization', startsWith: 'Bearer ' }.

match.description: Body/query/header match predicates lifted to mockstar match.* (equals/partial/jsonpath).

when.description: If present, this response becomes a mockstar scenario (scenarios[].when on params/query/headers/body).

statefulHints.description: Free-text note that this endpoint participates in stateful flow (e.g. 'POST creates, GET returns it'). Drives dynamic handler inference.

signing.description: Signature-scheme hint lifted to webhooks[].signing. Requires mockstar >= 0.3.0 and a $schema pinned to v0.3; omit entirely on older runtimes.

enabled.description: Signing is opt-in; mockstar defaults this to false.

provider.description: Named recipe from the provider cookbook in mockstar-mapping.md. Expands to the four wire-format fields; 'custom' means they are given explicitly.

secretRef.description: `{{ env.NAME }}` or `file:/path`. Inline secrets are rejected by mockstar at config-load (S3).

signedPayload.description: Bytes fed to HMAC. Single-brace placeholders: {body} (required), {timestamp}, {timestampSeconds}.

signatureTemplate.description: Header value around the digest. Single-brace placeholders: {signature} (required), {algorithm}, {timestamp}, {timestampSeconds}.

timestampHeader.description: null suppresses the standalone timestamp header (Stripe carries its timestamp inside signatureHeader).

replayWindowMs.description: Receiver-side replay window advertised in docs. mockstar defaults to 300000.

source.description: Input file path or URL this record came from.

locator.description: JSON pointer, line range, heading, or operationId within the source.

confidence.description: grounded = explicit in a source; inferred = reasoned from context (flagged in the coverage report).
